comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Nice that you're running your own backtester, since you can see exactly how fills and exits are handled. That high win rate on this few trades would make me cautious, especially when the winners look small compared to the losers. I'd check it against more days, with fees and slippage added, and on a stretch you didn't tune on. Cymetica's Backtest Labs includes fees and holds out the last part of the history, if you want a second check next to your own.
